package web

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"math"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/gogogadget/gogogadget/internal/api"
	"github.com/gogogadget/gogogadget/internal/db/sqlc"
	"github.com/gogogadget/gogogadget/internal/identity"
	"github.com/gogogadget/gogogadget/internal/search"
	"github.com/gogogadget/gogogadget/internal/web/templates"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

// exampleResourcePageSize is the rows-per-page of the read surfaces.
const exampleResourcePageSize = 20

// exampleResourceFormInput is the HTML form body.
// The JSON transport has its own request type; both run the same validator, so
// the two transports cannot disagree about what a valid name is.
type exampleResourceFormInput struct {
	Name string `form:"name"`
}

// validateExampleResourceName is that shared rule: required,
// 80 characters or fewer after trimming. It returns the cleaned value and a
// message, empty when valid.
func validateExampleResourceName(name string) (string, string) {
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	switch {
	case name == "":
		return name, "Name is required."
	case len(name) > 80:
		return name, "Name must be 80 characters or fewer."
	default:
		return name, ""
	}
}

// GET /app/example-resources
//
// The read surface: search, pagination, and the create/edit form on one page.
// ?edit=<id> loads a row into that form, so editing needs neither a second
// route nor a second template.
func (s *Server) handleExampleResources(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	org := identity.OrgFrom(ctx)
	query := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("q"))
	pageNumber, _ := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("page"))
	if pageNumber < 1 {
		pageNumber = 1
	}
	total, err := s.q.CountExampleResources(ctx, sqlc.CountExampleResourcesParams{Tenant: org.OrgID, Query: query})
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	rows, err := s.q.ListExampleResources(ctx, sqlc.ListExampleResourcesParams{Tenant: org.OrgID, Query: query, Lim: exampleResourcePageSize, Off: int32((pageNumber - 1) * exampleResourcePageSize)})
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	// An explicit view row rather than the query row: the template package then
	// depends on nothing generated, and adding a column cannot silently change
	// what the table renders.
	items := make([]templates.ExampleResourceItem, 0, len(rows))
	for _, row := range rows {
		items = append(items, templates.ExampleResourceItem{ID: row.ID, Name: row.Name, CreatedAt: row.CreatedAt.Time})
	}
	data := templates.ExampleResourcesListData{
		Items: items, Query: query, Page: pageNumber,
		TotalPages: max(int(math.Ceil(float64(total)/exampleResourcePageSize)), 1),
		BaseURL:    "/app/example-resources",
	}
	if raw := r.URL.Query().Get("edit"); raw != "" {
		id, parseErr := strconv.ParseInt(raw, 10, 64)
		if parseErr != nil {
			s.handleNotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		// A row outside the caller's tenant is a 404, never a 403: a 403 would
		// confirm that the id exists.
		row, getErr := s.q.GetExampleResourceByID(ctx, sqlc.GetExampleResourceByIDParams{ID: id, Tenant: org.OrgID})
		if errors.Is(getErr, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
			s.handleNotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		if getErr != nil {
			s.renderError(w, r, getErr.Error())
			return
		}
		data.Form = templates.ExampleResourceFormData{ID: row.ID, Name: row.Name}
	}
	pageData := Page{Title: "Example resources", Layout: templates.LayoutApp}
	if wantsFragment(r) {
		s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.ExampleResourcesTable(data))
		return
	}
	s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.ExampleResourcesPage(data))
}

// renderExampleResourceFormError re-renders the form with 422:
// the fragment for htmx, which swaps it into #example-resource-form, and the standalone
// form page otherwise.
func (s *Server) renderExampleResourceFormError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, form templates.ExampleResourceFormData) {
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
	pageData := Page{Title: "Example resources", Layout: templates.LayoutApp}
	if wantsFragment(r) {
		s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.ExampleResourceForm(form))
		return
	}
	s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.ExampleResourceFormPage(form))
}

// POST /app/example-resources
func (s *Server) handleExampleResourceCreate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	org := identity.OrgFrom(ctx)
	user := identity.UserFrom(ctx)
	var input exampleResourceFormInput
	if err := decodeForm(r, &input); err != nil {
		s.renderExampleResourceFormError(w, r, templates.ExampleResourceFormData{})
		return
	}
	name, nameErr := validateExampleResourceName(input.Name)
	if nameErr != "" {
		s.renderExampleResourceFormError(w, r, templates.ExampleResourceFormData{Name: name, NameErr: nameErr})
		return
	}
	row, err := s.q.CreateExampleResource(ctx, sqlc.CreateExampleResourceParams{Tenant: org.OrgID, Name: name})
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	s.logAudit(ctx, org.OrgID, user.UserID, "example_resource.created", map[string]any{"id": row.ID, "name": row.Name})
	s.indexExampleResource(ctx, org.OrgID, strconv.FormatInt(row.ID, 10), row.Name)
	Toast(w, "success", "Example resource created")
	Navigate(w, r, "/app/example-resources")
}

// POST /app/example-resources/{id}
func (s *Server) handleExampleResourceUpdate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	org := identity.OrgFrom(ctx)
	user := identity.UserFrom(ctx)
	id, err := strconv.ParseInt(r.PathValue("id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		s.handleNotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	var input exampleResourceFormInput
	if decodeErr := decodeForm(r, &input); decodeErr != nil {
		s.renderExampleResourceFormError(w, r, templates.ExampleResourceFormData{ID: id})
		return
	}
	name, nameErr := validateExampleResourceName(input.Name)
	if nameErr != "" {
		s.renderExampleResourceFormError(w, r, templates.ExampleResourceFormData{ID: id, Name: name, NameErr: nameErr})
		return
	}
	// The tenant predicate is in the UPDATE, so a cross-tenant id matches no
	// row and arrives here as ErrNoRows: one round trip, no existence leak.
	row, err := s.q.UpdateExampleResource(ctx, sqlc.UpdateExampleResourceParams{ID: id, Tenant: org.OrgID, Name: name})
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		s.handleNotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	s.logAudit(ctx, org.OrgID, user.UserID, "example_resource.updated", map[string]any{"id": row.ID, "name": row.Name})
	s.indexExampleResource(ctx, org.OrgID, strconv.FormatInt(row.ID, 10), row.Name)
	Toast(w, "success", "Example resource updated")
	Navigate(w, r, "/app/example-resources")
}

// DELETE /app/example-resources/{id}
//
// Row swap: 200 with an empty body, and htmx removes the tr.
func (s *Server) handleExampleResourceDelete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	org := identity.OrgFrom(ctx)
	user := identity.UserFrom(ctx)
	id, err := strconv.ParseInt(r.PathValue("id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		s.handleNotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	affected, err := s.q.DeleteExampleResource(ctx, sqlc.DeleteExampleResourceParams{ID: id, Tenant: org.OrgID})
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	if affected == 0 {
		s.handleNotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	s.logAudit(ctx, org.OrgID, user.UserID, "example_resource.deleted", map[string]any{"id": id})
	s.deleteExampleResourceIndex(ctx, org.OrgID, strconv.FormatInt(id, 10))
	Toast(w, "success", "Example resource deleted")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}

// GET /admin/example-resources
//
// The staff read surface. It renders the same table with ReadOnly set, so it
// cannot become a second write path by accident.
func (s *Server) handleAdminExampleResources(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	query := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("q"))
	pageNumber, _ := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("page"))
	if pageNumber < 1 {
		pageNumber = 1
	}
	total, err := s.q.CountAllExampleResources(ctx, query)
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	rows, err := s.q.ListAllExampleResources(ctx, sqlc.ListAllExampleResourcesParams{Query: query, Lim: exampleResourcePageSize, Off: int32((pageNumber - 1) * exampleResourcePageSize)})
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	// An explicit view row rather than the query row: the template package then
	// depends on nothing generated, and adding a column cannot silently change
	// what the table renders.
	items := make([]templates.ExampleResourceItem, 0, len(rows))
	for _, row := range rows {
		items = append(items, templates.ExampleResourceItem{ID: row.ID, Name: row.Name, CreatedAt: row.CreatedAt.Time})
	}
	data := templates.ExampleResourcesListData{
		Items: items, Query: query, Page: pageNumber,
		TotalPages: max(int(math.Ceil(float64(total)/exampleResourcePageSize)), 1),
		BaseURL:    "/admin/example-resources", ReadOnly: true,
	}
	pageData := Page{Title: "Example resources", Layout: templates.LayoutAdmin}
	if wantsFragment(r) {
		s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.ExampleResourcesTable(data))
		return
	}
	s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.AdminExampleResourcesPage(data))
}

// exampleResourceResponse is the public shape of one row.
// An explicit DTO, not the query row: pinning the fields here means adding a
// column can never silently change the API.
type exampleResourceResponse struct {
	ID        int64  `json:"id"`
	Name      string `json:"name"`
	CreatedAt string `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt string `json:"updated_at"`
}

func newExampleResourceResponse(id int64, name string, createdAt, updatedAt time.Time) exampleResourceResponse {
	return exampleResourceResponse{
		ID: id, Name: name,
		CreatedAt: createdAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
		UpdatedAt: updatedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
	}
}

type exampleResourceAPIRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

// GET /api/v1/example-resources (scope read).
func (s *Server) handleAPIListExampleResources(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	org := identity.OrgFrom(ctx)
	limit, _ := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("limit"))
	if limit <= 0 || limit > 100 {
		limit = 50
	}
	offset, _ := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("offset"))
	if offset < 0 {
		offset = 0
	}
	// The JSON transport does not expose the UI's free-text filter, so the
	// shared query runs with an empty one, which matches every row.
	query := ""
	rows, err := s.q.ListExampleResources(ctx, sqlc.ListExampleResourcesParams{Tenant: org.OrgID, Query: query, Lim: int32(limit), Off: int32(offset)})
	if err != nil {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error", "Could not list example resources.")
		return
	}
	out := make([]exampleResourceResponse, 0, len(rows))
	for _, row := range rows {
		out = append(out, newExampleResourceResponse(row.ID, row.Name, row.CreatedAt.Time, row.UpdatedAt.Time))
	}
	api.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": out, "limit": limit, "offset": offset})
}

// POST /api/v1/example-resources (scope write).
func (s *Server) handleAPICreateExampleResource(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	org := identity.OrgFrom(ctx)
	var request exampleResourceAPIRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request); err != nil {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_json", `Request body must be JSON: {"name": "…"}.`)
		return
	}
	name, nameErr := validateExampleResourceName(request.Name)
	if nameErr != "" {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "validation_error", nameErr)
		return
	}
	row, err := s.q.CreateExampleResource(ctx, sqlc.CreateExampleResourceParams{Tenant: org.OrgID, Name: name})
	if err != nil {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error", "Could not create the example resource.")
		return
	}
	// The token carries an organization and no user, so the audit actor is the
	// organization with an empty user rather than a guess.
	s.logAudit(ctx, org.OrgID, "", "example_resource.created", map[string]any{"id": row.ID, "name": row.Name, "via": "api"})
	s.indexExampleResource(ctx, org.OrgID, strconv.FormatInt(row.ID, 10), row.Name)
	api.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, newExampleResourceResponse(row.ID, row.Name, row.CreatedAt.Time, row.UpdatedAt.Time))
}

// PATCH /api/v1/example-resources/{id} (scope write).
func (s *Server) handleAPIUpdateExampleResource(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	org := identity.OrgFrom(ctx)
	id, err := strconv.ParseInt(r.PathValue("id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "No such example resource.")
		return
	}
	var request exampleResourceAPIRequest
	if decodeErr := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request); decodeErr != nil {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_json", `Request body must be JSON: {"name": "…"}.`)
		return
	}
	name, nameErr := validateExampleResourceName(request.Name)
	if nameErr != "" {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "validation_error", nameErr)
		return
	}
	row, err := s.q.UpdateExampleResource(ctx, sqlc.UpdateExampleResourceParams{ID: id, Tenant: org.OrgID, Name: name})
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "No such example resource.")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error", "Could not update the example resource.")
		return
	}
	s.logAudit(ctx, org.OrgID, "", "example_resource.updated", map[string]any{"id": row.ID, "name": row.Name, "via": "api"})
	s.indexExampleResource(ctx, org.OrgID, strconv.FormatInt(row.ID, 10), row.Name)
	api.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, newExampleResourceResponse(row.ID, row.Name, row.CreatedAt.Time, row.UpdatedAt.Time))
}

// DELETE /api/v1/example-resources/{id} (scope write).
func (s *Server) handleAPIDeleteExampleResource(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	org := identity.OrgFrom(ctx)
	id, err := strconv.ParseInt(r.PathValue("id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "No such example resource.")
		return
	}
	affected, err := s.q.DeleteExampleResource(ctx, sqlc.DeleteExampleResourceParams{ID: id, Tenant: org.OrgID})
	if err != nil {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error", "Could not delete the example resource.")
		return
	}
	if affected == 0 {
		api.WriteError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "No such example resource.")
		return
	}
	s.logAudit(ctx, org.OrgID, "", "example_resource.deleted", map[string]any{"id": id, "via": "api"})
	s.deleteExampleResourceIndex(ctx, org.OrgID, strconv.FormatInt(id, 10))
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// indexExampleResource and deleteExampleResourceIndex keep the search document
// for one row in step with the table. Both are fire-and-forget: a search hiccup
// must never fail the mutation that already succeeded.
func (s *Server) indexExampleResource(ctx context.Context, tenantID, id, name string) {
	if s.searchIndex == nil {
		return
	}
	_ = s.searchIndex.Upsert(ctx, search.Document{TenantID: tenantID, Collection: "example_resources", ID: id, Text: name})
}

func (s *Server) deleteExampleResourceIndex(ctx context.Context, tenantID, id string) {
	if s.searchIndex != nil {
		_ = s.searchIndex.Delete(ctx, tenantID, "example_resources", id)
	}
}
